objective: Determine without refitting whether the predeclared bounded top-2k rule retains the confirmed average top-five shortlist gain while eliminating the family-specific harm of unbounded winner filling.

methods.unbounded_winner_fill: Preserve the complete broad-RFF winner group and rank every remaining candidate by SAVE+RFF.
methods.bounded_2k: Preserve the complete broad-RFF winner group; retrieve complete broad-RFF groups until at least min(2k,16) candidates are retained; rank the remainder of that pool by SAVE+RFF before all outside candidates. At k=5 the nominal retrieval depth is 10.

ties.retrieval_cutoff: Include a complete broad-RFF group crossing depth 2k.
ties.shortlist_cutoff: Uniformly average all top-k subsets admitted by a rank-group tie.

bootstrap.unit: seed panel within equal-weight target family
bootstrap.pairing: Every contrast preserves seed and family.

decision_rule.primary: upper95 candidate-minus-broad top5 mean utility regret < 0
safety: maximum absolute panel top1 regret difference from broad_rff <= 1e-12
maximum family-mean candidate-minus-broad top5 mean utility regret <= 0.03
all 30 panels and 90 panel-method metric rows complete and finite
decision_rule.pass: Every primary and safety criterion must pass.

interpretation: A pass only justifies one new unused-seed confirmation of bounded_2k. This post-outcome diagnostic cannot promote, integrate, tune, or replace the failed unbounded confirmation.
execution: No model fit, transform, score, or outcome generation. Reanalyze only the hash-bound stored confirmation panels.
